diagnostic_table_contract.mass_weighting: host eta dry mass retained; no mass-weighted water path is reported
diagnostic_table_contract.maxsat_semantics: KDM6 thermo.compute_qs_ice phase-aware qv/qs diagnostic; also report qv/qs_water; neither is claimed as observed vapor-pressure RH
diagnostic_table_contract.number_units: Registry raw QN fields retained; # kg-1 basis not specified dry-vs-moist; QIB m3 kg-1; no calibration/conversion claim
per_cell_metrics: KDM6 phase-aware max qv/qs ratio and layer
all hydrometeor raw maxima and nonzero counts
diagnostic_table_contract.qc_sum_semantics: unweighted native-level QC sum is not LWP, not a path integral, and not a water budget

geography_only_source.viirs_region_filter: center-in-axis-aligned-bounds-of-native-3x3-centers; descriptive only, not nine-cell union or physical footprint

native_intake.forecast_integrity_contract: reuse existing runner validity/identity and intake receipt; selected hyperslabs only; no multi-gigabyte whole-file hash

planned_arrays.native_patch__p_centers_native_bottomup_: [3,3,3,39] float64-first P+PB; same values as Forcing.p
planned_arrays.native_patch__state__<12 KDM6 fields>: [3,3,3,39] float64; th follows selected_frame THM/QVAPOR conversion
planned_arrays.native_patch__surface__<fields>: [3,3,3] selected scalar surface and XLAND/SEAICE/geolocation values

read_contract.center_crosscheck: j86/i48 arrays must equal existing PR395 intake arrays at frames 1/4/6 before publication
read_contract.duplicate_small_reads: P/PB/PH/PHB hyperslabs are re-read inside p8w_for_column; no single-read claim
read_contract.interface_slices: only PH/PHB [time_index,:,j,i] for 40 interfaces at each cell
read_contract.p8w: authoritative archived reader p8w_for_column per cell; Python REAL(4) transcription, not an executed host output
read_contract.selected_3d_slices: only ds[name][time_index,:,j,i] for each of nine fixed cells
read_contract.vertical_coefficients: FNM/FNP/C1H/C2H/DNW vectors of 39 values once per frame

reconstruction_provenance.center_pressure: float64-first P + PB from stored REAL(4) fields
reconstruction_provenance.cloud_fields: native WRF Q fields copied by selected_frame, then packed in public KDM6 State field order

host_dry_mass.provenance: host eta-coordinate layer dry-mass measure derived from native MU/MUB/C1H/C2H/DNW; distinct from EOS rho_m*delz and not a process budget
host_dry_mass.units: kg dry air m-2 per native eta layer

interface_pressure.method: Python REAL(4) transcription of calc_p8w; not an executed host output
interface_pressure.precision_note: P+PB REAL(4), WRF REAL(4) operations; distinct from raw PH/PHB

reconstruction_provenance.p8w_formula: reader.p8w_for_column REAL(4) transcription of pinned calc_p8w; not executed host output
reconstruction_provenance.physical_temperature_formula: T_K = th*pii; th from (THM+300)/(1+(Rv/Rd)*QVAPOR), selected_frame convention

registry_source.number_species_units: Registry labels # kg-1; dry/moist denominator basis not specified
registry_source.water_species_units: Registry labels kg kg-1; dry/moist denominator basis not specified in this receipt

selected_reader.function: selected_frame; formulas replicated for neighbor cells without its center-ocean-only reject

reconstruction_provenance.temperature: THM plus 300 K, divided by Exner and with Rv/Rd moisture correction as archived selected_frame; State.th carries dry potential temperature
reconstruction_provenance.water_vapor: native QVAPOR retained as kg kg-1 dry-air mixing ratio

scope: bounded 3x3 native selected-column patch from an already accepted forecast; no M/H, optimization, new run, reanalysis, or acquisition

selection.orientation: WRF j/i, bottom-up vertical; arrays do not remap or select a replacement column
selection.sampling: all nine fixed cells at each of the same three predeclared saved frames
